title: Consider Reaction Rate
text: Equilibrium position tells us how much product forms eventually, but rate tells us how fast we get there.

title: Temperature and Rate
text: Lower temperature = slower reaction rate. At very low temperatures, equilibrium might never be reached in practical time.

title: The Compromise
text: 450 degrees C is a compromise: fast enough rate for economic production, with acceptable (though not maximum) yield. The iron catalyst speeds up the reaction without changing the equilibrium position.
